Basic chat completion via the Google Vertex AI provider using the vertex_ai/ prefix for routing — verifies the prefix is stripped before dispatching and the Gemini response is normalised to the standard OpenAI chat completion shape

```swift title="Swift"
import LiterLlm

let _request = try LiterLlm.chatCompletionRequestFromJson("{\"max_tokens\":16,\"messages\":[{\"content\":\"Say hello in one word.\",\"role\":\"user\"}],\"model\":\"vertex_ai/gemini-2.0-flash\",\"temperature\":0}")
let result = try await LiterLlm.chat(request: _request)
print(result)
```
